actions.label: unscrew-bottle-cap
actions.instruction: Continue from the shown open-bottle state: the cap is already fully detached and held by the left robot gripper while the right robot gripper holds the open bottle. Lift and turn the detached cap for inspection, separate both hands, and finish by displaying the open bottle and cap apart.
actions.timeline: This is the continuation at absolute 4.833-10.000 seconds of one uncut action. Local 2.000-4.200 seconds: move both grippers farther apart and inspect the cap while preserving the open neck. Local 4.200-5.167 seconds: finish with subtle natural hand motion in a clear open-bottle display pose, cap in the left gripper and bottle in the right gripper. actions.label: rinse-bottle
actions.instruction: Continue from the shown rinsing state with the same blue bottle held in the right robot gripper beneath the faucet. Rotate and sweep it through several additional rinsing orientations, return it upright, and move it out of the water while keeping the grasp.
actions.timeline: This is the continuation at absolute 4.833-10.000 seconds of one uncut action.
